question: Which exact .139 native entries, Thumb callback identities, data classes and RAM roots are required by the unified restricted font reload transaction, given the individually verified .155-to-.139 compatibility receipt?
prototype_hypothesis: Direct native leaves use restricted recovered ARM AAPCS prototypes. Identity-only or installed callbacks intentionally have no public prototype: their addresses/layout roles are audited, not promoted into a general callable ABI. All functions have even instruction entry and entry|1 Thumb callable; RAM/data have only their exact address.
callsite_evidence: Exact .139 AP: 12304868 bytes, SHA256 31ce82257f7c127950dc5070b86316730cf468a41f0d004559e41e7d923b2c74. Upstream supplied full container SHA256 a02b7af5959e1bb98d35a5b98dca075dd0aa8a4e02ebe00b8d6f7ec1fe9a1c16; its vela_ap.bin member is byte-identical to this AP. XIP file offset = address - 0x0c0c0000; cached-flash data offset = address - 0x2c0c0000. Fingerprint windows are identity evidence only, not function extents or allowlist ranges; short functions include subsequent bytes in a 32-byte window.

45 original adapter identities: 36 unchanged, nine individually mapped substitutions. Add only 42 exact records (31 functions, eight RAM globals, three cached-flash classes); reuse existing lv_obj_tree_walk 0x0c380574, lv_obj_refresh_style 0x0c38525c and lv_cache_drop 0x0c8b8cae unchanged. No unrelated transitive callee becomes allowlisted.

Five new function identities move: vector_compare 0x0c69feb0 -> 0x0c69fec0, vector_destroy 0x0c6a12d4 -> 0x0c6a12e4, vector_drop 0x0c6a1304 -> 0x0c6a1314, ft_set_pixel_size 0x0c8b8a54 -> 0x0c8b8a64, cache_release 0x0c8b9780 -> 0x0c8b9790. All other added identities are unchanged.
